data.body:
[P1] Avoid holding native capacity while waiting for the semaphore

With `scenarioConcurrency: 1`, a suspended callback case retains the semaphore while releasing its native capacity. A queued case can then acquire that capacity and block here on the semaphore. The suspended case's `reserve_capacity()` now waits for the queued case, creating a circular wait until a phase timeout fails the run and quarantines the target. Coordinate admission so semaphore waiters cannot reserve capacity needed by active suspended owners. Add a regression with a suspended case followed by another case on a capacity-one profile under serial execution.
